canonical_name: No Limits on Uses and Disclosures
description: No limits on uses and disclosures of PHI; disclosures made beyond permitted or required purposes.
applicability: This signal applies to: Healthcare providers with direct patient relationships Health plans and insurers Healthcare clearinghouses Business associates handling PHI Patient-facing systems and portals Marketing and communications functions

metadata.detection_notes: Detection of this signal may occur when: PHI is used or disclosed for purposes not explicitly permitted by HIPAA Disclosures are made without proper authorization or legal basis PHI is shared beyond the scope of permitted purposes Monitoring reveals uses and disclosures that exceed regulatory permissions

sources.title: 45 CFR Part 164 Subpart E - Privacy Rule
